name: your god is a stranger
source:
You stay up writing your book again. You're working on a very tight deadline and you don't really have a choice. But right as you decide you should take a quick nap because of how exhausted you are, you wake up in the fantasy world you're writing about.

[From [url=https://q-uwu-q.itch.io/your-god-is-a-stranger]itch.io[/url]]
